descriptor.s_telegram.title: Telegram
descriptor.s_telegram.description: Deliver notifications through a Telegram bot to one chat.
descriptor.s_telegram.botToken.label: Bot Token
descriptor.s_telegram.chatId.label: Chat ID
descriptor.s_telegram.chatId.description: Numeric chat/user id, or @channelusername. DM the bot first, then pick the chat from the list once the token is set.
descriptor.s_telegram.defaultParseMode.d: HTML avoids the MarkdownV2 escaping pitfalls; it is the only supported mode.
descriptor.s_telegram.defaultSilent.desc: Send with notification sound suppressed unless a message overrides it.
ntfyConfig.s_connection.title: Connection
ntfyConfig.s_connection.serverUrl.label: Server URL
ntfyConfig.s_connection.topic.label: Topic
ntfyConfig.s_connection.topic.descriptio: The ntfy topic to publish to. Treat as a secret — anyone with it can post.
ntfyConfig.s_connection.token.label: Access token
ntfyConfig.s_connection.token.descriptio: Bearer token (tk_…). Takes precedence over username/password.
ntfyConfig.s_connection.user.label: Username
ntfyConfig.s_connection.user.description: HTTP Basic auth username (used when no access token is set).
ntfyConfig.s_connection.pass.label: Password
ntfyConfig.s_defaults.title: Defaults
ntfyConfig.s_defaults.tags.label: Default tags
ntfyConfig.s_defaults.tags.description: Emoji shortcodes or labels sent with every notification (e.g. "warning", "camera").
descriptor.s_pushover.title: Pushover
descriptor.s_pushover.appToken.label: Application API Token
descriptor.s_pushover.userOrGroupKey.des: The recipient user key or delivery group key.
descriptor.s_pushover.device.label: Device (optional)
descriptor.s_pushover.device.description: Restrict delivery to one device by name. Blank = all devices.
descriptor.s_pushover.defaultSound.label: Default Sound (optional)
descriptor.s_pushover.defaultSound.descr: Sound name used when a notification omits its own.
descriptor.s_pushover.retry.label: Emergency Retry (seconds)
descriptor.s_pushover.retry.description: How often Pushover re-alerts until acknowledged. Emergency only. Min 30.
descriptor.s_pushover.expire.label: Emergency Expire (seconds)
descriptor.s_pushover.expire.description: How long emergency alerts keep retrying. Emergency only. Max 10800.
emailDescriptor.s_email.title: Email
emailDescriptor.s_email.description: Send via a Connectivity → Email provider (Google or Email (SMTP)). Install and Verify a provider first.
emailDescriptor.s_email.to.label: To
emailDescriptor.s_email.from.label: From (optional)
emailDescriptor.s_email.from.description: Override From when the relay allows it.
discordConfig.s_discord.title: Discord Webhook
discordConfig.s_discord.webhookUrl.label: Webhook URL
discordConfig.s_discord.webhookUrl.descr: Full Discord webhook URL. The token is embedded in the URL, so it is stored as a secret.
discordConfig.s_discord.username.label: Username
discordConfig.s_discord.username.descrip: Optional override for the webhook display name.
discordConfig.s_discord.avatarUrl.label: Avatar URL
discordConfig.s_discord.avatarUrl.descri: Optional override for the webhook avatar image.
zentikConfig.s_connection.title: Connection
zentikConfig.s_connection.baseUrl.label: Server URL
zentikConfig.s_connection.baseUrl.descri: Zentik API base URL. Change only for a self-hosted instance.
zentikConfig.s_connection.authMode.label: Authentication
zentikConfig.s_connection.accessToken.de: Personal access token (sent as a Bearer token).
zentikConfig.s_connection.bucketId.label: Bucket ID or name
zentikConfig.s_connection.bucketId.descr: Target bucket. Accepts a bucket id or its name.
zentikConfig.s_connection.magicCode.desc: A bucket's magic code — publishes without a login. Alternative to token + bucket.
zentikConfig.s_connection.userIds.label: User IDs (or usernames)
zentikConfig.s_connection.userIds.descri: Optional. If the bucket is shared, target specific users (comma-separated ids or usernames). Leave blank to deliver to all users.
zentikConfig.s_defaults.title: Defaults
zentikConfig.s_defaults.defaultDeliveryT: Used when a notification does not resolve to a specific level.
config.s_connection.title: Connection
config.s_connection.serverUrl.label: Server URL
config.s_connection.serverUrl.descriptio: Base URL of your Gotify server (no trailing /message).
config.s_connection.appToken.label: Application Token
config.s_connection.appToken.description: The message token of a Gotify application (Apps → your app).
config.s_connection.adminToken.label: Client/Admin Token (optional)
config.s_connection.adminToken.descripti: A client token used only for discovery (GET /application). Leave blank to add applications manually.
config.s_defaults.title: Defaults
config.s_defaults.defaultPriority.label: Default priority
config.s_defaults.defaultPriority.descri: Native Gotify priority used when a notification does not resolve a level.
config.s_defaults.contentType.label: Default content type
config.s_defaults.contentType.descriptio: Advisory default. The per-notification format wins: markdown bodies always send text/markdown.
webhookConfig.s_webhook.title: Webhook
webhookConfig.s_webhook.url.label: Endpoint URL
webhookConfig.s_webhook.url.description: HTTP(S) endpoint the canonical notification JSON is POSTed to. Treated as a secret: many webhook URLs carry their token in the path or query.
webhookConfig.s_webhook.method.label: HTTP method
webhookConfig.s_webhook.headers.label: Static headers
webhookConfig.s_webhook.headers.descript: Sent verbatim on every request. Values are treated as secrets (e.g. an Authorization bearer token).
config.s_whatsapp.title: WhatsApp / Green API
config.s_whatsapp.description: Delivers via Green API. Against Meta ToS — use a dedicated number; the account can be banned.
config.s_whatsapp.tosWarning.label: Experimental — read before enabling
config.s_whatsapp.apiHostMode.label: API host
config.s_whatsapp.apiHostMode.descriptio: Universal works for most instances. Use a cluster host when the Green API console shows a dedicated apiUrl, or Custom to paste it verbatim.
config.s_whatsapp.apiUrl.label: Custom API URL
config.s_whatsapp.apiUrl.description: Copy apiUrl from your Green API console.
config.s_whatsapp.mediaUrl.label: Media URL (optional)
config.s_whatsapp.mediaUrl.description: Optional media host from the console. Leave blank to mirror the API host. Not required for send-by-URL delivery.
config.s_whatsapp.idInstance.label: Instance ID (idInstance)
config.s_whatsapp.apiTokenInstance.label: API Token (apiTokenInstance)
config.s_whatsapp.chatId.label: Chat ID / phone number
config.s_whatsapp.chatId.description: Recipient in international format without "+", or a full WhatsApp id (…@c.us / …@g.us). Instance must be authorized in the Green API console.
config.s_whatsapp.acknowledgeToS.label: I understand the ban risk and accept the WhatsApp Terms-of-Service violation
